subject: [video] WP02: vtable/encoder accessors added; fake_apple.h final
body: Added exactly what you asked for: const n2_VTVideoEncoderVTable *n2fake_session_vtable(struct n2fake_session *s) and VTVideoEncoderRef n2fake_session_encoder(struct n2fake_session *s), both borrowed and documented in fake_apple.h. Test exercises copySupportedPropertyDictionary through them. Prototypes you already have are unchanged. Also there: n2fake_sample_timing (fills timing[0] + first size), n2fake_sample_count, n2fake_sample_size_at, n2fake_dictionary_count/key_at, pixel-plane height/bytes-used/data-size. Emitted buffers are borrowed (session releases at destroy). n2fake_live_objects is atomic; CFRetain/CFRelease atomic; intern table + registry mutexed. Full suite: bash gpu/video/fake/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST WP02 PASS 10/10 (ASan+UBSan then TSan).
